task.description: Execute the ADP-04a test specification and produce a structured test report. Run the tests that exercise additive migration defaults, internal-user backward compatibility, realm+sub uniqueness, JIT provisioning linkage, and tenant-isolation collision boundaries. Record results in tests/reports/ with explicit pass/fail status per case and summarize any gaps or failures. Design the report only if tests need no changes; otherwise note required fixes. Do not modify implementation code.
acceptance_criteria: All ADP-04a spec cases are executed or explicitly mapped to existing automated tests
Test report clearly marks pass/fail for each case
Any failures include reproducible details and affected artifacts
Handoff closeout is synced to registry

result.summary: The ADP-04a integration target passed against the real PostgreSQL test database, but the spec is not fully covered: TC-ADP-04a-06 has no explicit automated test.

issues.description: TC-ADP-04a-06 is not explicitly covered by an automated test. The current suite validates OIDC linkage, idempotent provisioning, and tenant-collision behavior, but it does not exercise multiple internal NULL-linkage rows coexisting alongside duplicate non-NULL realm/sub rejection or schema metadata inspection for the unique external-identity index.
